goal: Make the site's discovery documents (llms.txt, agent.json, .well-known/*) name working paths so an agent that reads them derives a URL that answers

laws.statement: Every origin-relative path named in the site's discovery documents answers 200 on the origin that serves the document.
laws.oracle: probe each documented path on the live origin; a 404 fails

laws.statement: Every discovery document states the API base as the single origin-relative path /unstuck/api and never names the bare origin root as an API base.
laws.oracle: parse each doc, assert api_path/api fields equal /unstuck/api and no endpoint resolves against root
